We are forced to conclude that the assumption made by Einstein, Podolsky, and Rosen, no matter how reasonable it seems, cannot be how our quantum universe works. Thus, through this indirect but carefully considered reasoning, the exper iments lead us to conclude that an object over there does care about what you do to another object over here.
